summary: Retested at 390x844 viewport with localStorage cleared. BOTH P0 flows now PASS. (1) Onboarding fix verified: from a fresh state, tapping [data-testid=onb-next] three times updates the local index deterministically — CTA label progresses AVANTI → AVANTI → INIZIA, and the 3rd tap invokes finish() → markDone() → router.replace('/(auth)/sign-in') so [data-testid=landing-signin] appears (no loop). scrollToOffset + immediate setIndex works reliably on RN Web. (2) Full regression happy-path also PASSES: login (fan@meetchampion.local/demo1234) → Explore rail-list loaded → tap first card (card-champ-baggio) → Champion Detail → svc-video selected → slot selected → book-btn → Checkout (Riepilogo Ordine, $449.00) → pay-btn → Ticket with QR + 'ENTRA NELLA CALL' → join-btn navigates to /call/[id] → LIVE call UI with ctrl-end visible → tap ctrl-end returns to /booking/[id] with 'PAGAMENTO CONFERMATO' banner and review section (review-submit) rendered. No red-screen errors, only benign RN Web style-deprecation warnings (textShadow*/shadow*).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings from react-native-web: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'textShadow'; 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Sources include /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx (styles.title textShadow*, styles.cta shadow*) and likely other screens using elevation/shadowColor patterns.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated RN Web style props (textShadow* → textShadow shorthand, shadow*/elevation → boxShadow) to silence console warnings. Non-blocking for the reported bug.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx `next()` fix is correct: setIndex(nextIdx) is done synchronously before scrollToOffset, so the CTA label and dots reflect the new index without relying on FlatList.onViewableItemsChanged, which is unreliable on RN Web.
onViewableItemsChanged is still wired to keep gesture-scroll in sync — good defensive keep.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 P0 flows pass: onboarding 3xAVANTI→INIZIA→landing-signin; and full booking→call→review regression)

rca_of_issue: Previous root cause (iteration_1): FlatList.scrollToIndex on React Native Web does not fire onViewableItemsChanged, so `index` state stayed 0. Fix (this iteration): in onboarding.tsx `next()`, setIndex(nextIdx) is called immediately, and listRef.current.scrollToOffset({offset: nextIdx * SCREEN_W}) performs the visual scroll. CTA label and finish() now progress deterministically. Verified via Playwright: three sequential taps yield CTA 'AVANTI' → 'AVANTI' → 'INIZIA' and navigation to /sign-in with landing-signin visible.
